# Which roles answer an option of a component family?

Read this when your style plugin answers a role whose name carries a family option, such as a size, an elevation or an emphasis.

A component role is read by the component itself, and no markup of yours reads one. The `<option>` roles are stated in [`contracts/design/StylePlugins.md`](../../../../../contracts/design/StylePlugins.md#the-option-roles), under "The option roles". A component role draws from the scale of the plugin role with its prefix, as the [plugin pages](../plugin/index.md) name.

<!-- @tree GENERATED by bun run generate:token-tree. Edit that script, not this copy. -->

- [Which roles answer the air inside a component's own parts?](./air.md): Read this when your style plugin answers the padding, the gap or an edge of a part inside a component.
- [Which roles answer the type of a component's own parts?](./type.md): Read this when your style plugin answers the type of a part inside a component, such as a badge, a key or a meter.
- [Which roles answer the size of a control at each option?](./size-controls.md): Read this when your style plugin answers the size of a control, a segment, a switch, a spinner, a meter or a ring at one size option.
- [Which roles answer the size of content at each option?](./size-content.md): Read this when your style plugin answers the size of a part that is content rather than a control, at one size option.
- [Which roles answer an emphasis and an accent?](./emphasis-and-accent.md): Read this when your style plugin answers how loud an emphasis is, how deep an elevation stands or which accent a component takes.
- [Which roles answer a status hue?](./status-hues.md): Read this when your style plugin answers the hue a status, a tone or a category takes inside a component.
